# Pinwheel Galaxy — Agent Readability (llms.txt)

## What this site is

**Pinwheel Galaxy** is an ever-evolving, interactive generative art site. You
tune a live, physics-driven gravity-well starfield and shape your own galaxy —
arms, rotation, star density, colour theme, dust/nebula layers, motion — then
share the exact result as a single URL. There is no account, no backend, and no
server-side storage: the URL is the entire galaxy.

- **Live site:** https://pinwheel-galaxy.vercel.app
- **Source:** https://github.com/pefman/pinwheel-galaxy
- **Current version:** 0.11.0

## What an agent can help a user do

- **Generate a galaxy** — open the site; the starfield composes itself and reacts
  to cursor and controls.
- **Tune a galaxy** — adjust preset arms, rotation speed, star density, variable
  stars, gravity well, zoom, and layered effects (nebula drift, comet trail,
  shooting stars, stellar depth, constellation mode).
- **Share a galaxy** — every current state is encoded in the URL query string, so
  copying the address bar shares the exact galaxy. A galaxy can also be re-hydrated
  from a shared link.
- **Discover a daily galaxy** — a fresh, seeded "Galaxy of the Day" refreshes once
  per calendar day with a creative prompt.

## How the galaxy recipe works (for agents)

A galaxy is fully described by URL query parameters, so an agent can construct,
read, or re-create any galaxy without any API:

- `?theme=` — colour theme / palette
- `?arms=` — spiral arm count
- `?rpm=` — rotation speed
- `?stars=` — star density
- `?gravity=` — gravity-well strength
- `?z=` — zoom
- `?<layer>=on` — enable effect layers (e.g. `nebula`, `comet`, `shootingstars`,
  `stardepth`, `constellation`)
- `?recipe=` — a compact, URL-encoded recipe string that bundles the above

Any valid combination of these parameters re-hydrates a specific galaxy on open.

## Key pages / routes

- `/` — the interactive generator (single-page app; all sections live here).
- `/llms.txt` — this file (agent readability).
- `/agents.json` — machine-readable agent capabilities manifest.
- `/robots.txt` — crawler policy, links to this file.
- Source & bug reports live on GitHub: https://github.com/pefman/pinwheel-galaxy

## Agent notes

- The site is client-rendered (Next.js App Router). Content is present in the
  initial HTML; there is no server API to call.
- No authentication, no API keys, no rate limiting, no paid tiers.
- No privacy policy, terms of service, or cookie banner — nothing is collected.

## Sources & standards

- `llms.txt` / agent-readability: https://axd.md/
- agents.json vs WebMCP vs llms.txt: https://www.bridgetoagent.com/blog/agents-json-vs-webmcp
